From the manufacturer

Hawkins Classic Pressure Cooker

The Classic is Hawkins’ range of pressure cookers - perhaps because of its attractive combination of features benefits. This range was to be introduced by Hawkins and has been kept up to date by numerous innovations and improvements over the years. The improvement introduced , is a superior pressure regulating system that controls pressure to a narrower, more range, reduces sprouting of frothy foods (such as dal) and is easier to insert and remove.

About Us

Hawkins Cookers Limited has been in business since 1959. It is in the pressure cooker market in India and has exported its products since 1974 to various countries in each of the six continents of the world.

Mission:

We have one overarching goal: to win over customers, to truly please them by delivering products and service beyond their expectations, to earn their friendship and build relationships that will endure.

    How are ratings calculated?
    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers find the pressure cooker easy to use and consider it good value for money. The cooking performance and durability receive mixed feedback - while some say it works efficiently, others report issues with the cooker not working and safety valves breaking within months of use. Moreover, the lid design is problematic as it's hard to close and open, and the size receives mixed reviews with some finding it suitable for large meals while others note the separators are too small. Additionally, customers report leakage problems, with water spilling during use.

    About this Item

    • Ideal for 8 to 11 Persons
    • Made from pure virgin aluminium, exterior mirror polished
    • Base thickness 3.25 to 4.06 mm
    • Super-fast cooking
    • Improved pressure regulator − saves more fuel
    • Inside-fitting safety lid − will not open until pressure falls

    Product description

    The Classic is Hawkins’ largest-selling, most popular range of pressure cookers – perhaps because of its attractive combination of features, benefits and price. Each Hawkins Classic features an inside-fitting lid. This design is inherently safer than conventional cookers. Thus Hawkins Classic pressure cookers are pressure-locked for safety – like a jetliner door! This range was the first to be introduced by Hawkins and has been kept fresh and current by numerous innovations and improvements over the years. The latest improvement is a superior pressure regulating system that controls pressure to a narrower, more efficient range, reduces sprouting of frothy foods (such as dal) and is easier to insert and remove. The safety valve is located under the lid handle bar so that when it operates the steam is safely deflected downwards. The gasket has minimum exposure to steam inside the cooker, does not rub every time the product is opened and closed – so lasts longer. Stay-cool handles. Fixed sturdy pivot does not put pressure on the plastic handles as it is a part of the metal handle itself. Thus handles last longer. Recommended for use on gas stoves.
